ASSISTANTS.TITLE: JIVO AI
ASSISTANTS.DESCRIPTION: Configure AI assistants that automatically handle conversations on your inboxes.
ASSISTANTS.EMPTY: No JIVO assistants yet. Create your first one to get started.

ACCOUNT_V2_OVERRIDE.LABEL: Force V2 multi-agent runner for all assistants
ACCOUNT_V2_OVERRIDE.HELP: Account-wide override. When on, every JIVO assistant uses the V2 runner regardless of its individual setting.
ACCOUNT_V2_OVERRIDE.ENABLED: V2 runner now forced on for all assistants in this account.
ACCOUNT_V2_OVERRIDE.DISABLED: V2 runner is no longer forced. Per-assistant settings apply.
ACCOUNT_V2_OVERRIDE.ERROR: Could not update account-wide V2 setting.

DELETE.TITLE: Delete JIVO Assistant
DELETE.DESCRIPTION: Are you sure you want to delete '{name}'? This cannot be undone.

OPENAI_MODEL.LABEL: OpenAI Model
OPENAI_MODEL.VISION_WARNING: This model does not support image inputs. JIVO will run OCR on customer-shared images and pass the extracted text to the assistant instead.

SYSTEM_PROMPT.LABEL: Custom System Prompt (optional)
SYSTEM_PROMPT.PLACEHOLDER: Add custom instructions to the AI prompt...

HANDOFF_MESSAGE.LABEL: Handoff Message
HANDOFF_MESSAGE.PLACEHOLDER: Connecting you with a human agent...

AVATAR.HELP: PNG, JPG, or WEBP up to 2 MB. Square images render best.
AVATAR.SAVE_FIRST: Save the assistant before uploading an avatar.
AVATAR.INVALID_TYPE: Please choose a PNG, JPG, or WEBP image.

RESPONSE_GUIDELINES.LABEL: Response guidelines (one per line)
RESPONSE_GUIDELINES.PLACEHOLDER:
Always greet the customer by name
Cite specific pricing when discussing packages
RESPONSE_GUIDELINES.HELP: Each non-blank line is appended as a bullet under [Custom Response Guidelines] in the V2 system prompt.

GUARDRAILS.LABEL: Guardrails (one per line)
GUARDRAILS.PLACEHOLDER:
Never share competitor pricing
Do not provide medical or legal advice
GUARDRAILS.HELP: Each non-blank line is appended as a bullet under [Guardrails] in the V2 system prompt.

FEATURE_CITATION.LABEL: Show source citations on replies
FEATURE_CITATION.HELP: When the assistant answers from a knowledge base FAQ that has a source URL, attach a citation chip below the reply so customers can verify the answer.

FEATURE_V2_AGENT.LABEL: Use V2 multi-agent runner
FEATURE_V2_AGENT.HELP: Routes replies through the agent runner with built-in tools (FAQ lookup, handoff, notes, labels). Off = legacy direct OpenAI path.

IDLE_MESSAGE.LABEL: Idle message
IDLE_MESSAGE.PLACEHOLDER: Leave blank to use the default message

IDLE_REMINDER_LIMIT.LABEL: Reminder limit
IDLE_REMINDER_LIMIT.HELP_TEXT: Maximum number of reminder messages to send per conversation before stopping.

INBOXES.EMPTY: No inboxes connected. Connect an inbox to let this assistant respond there.

CONNECT_DIALOG.TITLE: Connect Inbox
CONNECT_DIALOG.DESCRIPTION: Choose an inbox to attach to this assistant. Each inbox can host only one assistant at a time.
CONNECT_DIALOG.EMPTY: All inboxes are already connected to this assistant.

DISCONNECT_DIALOG.TITLE: Disconnect Inbox
DISCONNECT_DIALOG.DESCRIPTION: Stop this assistant from responding in {name}?

DOCUMENTS.EMPTY: No documents yet. Add a URL to give JIVO knowledge to answer from.

FORM.PDF_HELP: Up to 10 MB. JIVO will extract the text and generate FAQs from it.
FORM.PDF_TOO_LARGE: File is larger than 10 MB. Please split it into smaller PDFs.
FORM.NAME_PLACEHOLDER: Auto-detected from page title or file name if blank

DELETE.TITLE: Delete Document
DELETE.DESCRIPTION: This will also remove all FAQs generated from this document.

FAQS.EMPTY: No FAQs yet. Add documents or create FAQs manually.

DELETE.TITLE: Delete FAQ
DELETE.DESCRIPTION: Are you sure? This cannot be undone.

APPROVE.TITLE: Approve selected FAQs
APPROVE.DESCRIPTION: This will approve {count} FAQ(s). Approved FAQs become available to JIVO for retrieval.

REJECT.TITLE: Reject selected FAQs
REJECT.DESCRIPTION: This will reject {count} FAQ(s). Rejected FAQs are removed from review and will not be used by JIVO.

DELETE.TITLE: Delete selected FAQs
DELETE.DESCRIPTION: This will permanently delete {count} FAQ(s). This cannot be undone.

TASKS.ERROR: JIVO task failed. Please try again.
TASKS.FOLLOW_UP_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. make it shorter, add a friendly tone

CONTACT_MEMORY.TITLE: Contact memory
CONTACT_MEMORY.HELP: Notes saved from past conversations. JIVO uses these to personalize replies.
CONTACT_MEMORY.EMPTY: No saved notes for this contact yet.

SUMMARIZE.TITLE: Summarize Conversation
SUMMARIZE.DESCRIPTION: Generate a concise summary of the entire conversation.

REPLY.TITLE: Suggest a Reply
REPLY.DESCRIPTION: Get an AI-drafted reply for the customer's last message.

REWRITE.TITLE: Rewrite Message
REWRITE.DESCRIPTION: Fix grammar or change the tone of any text.
REWRITE.PLACEHOLDER: Paste or type the message you want to rewrite...
REWRITE.SELECTION_NOTICE: Rewriting the text you selected in the reply box. The result will replace the selection.

LABEL.TITLE: Suggest Labels
LABEL.DESCRIPTION: Get label suggestions based on conversation content.

LEARN.TITLE: Learn from this conversation
LEARN.DESCRIPTION: Force-extract contact notes and FAQs from this conversation now (admin only).
LEARN.QUEUED: Learning queued. Notes and FAQs will appear shortly.

SCENARIOS.EMPTY: No scenarios yet. Create one to add a specialist sub-agent.

DESCRIPTION.LABEL: Description
DESCRIPTION.PLACEHOLDER: Handles UAE visa questions including extensions and tourist visas.

INSTRUCTION.LABEL: Instruction
INSTRUCTION.PLACEHOLDER: You handle all visa-related questions for Tabeer Tours. When the customer asks about availability, use [FAQ Lookup](tool://faq_lookup).
INSTRUCTION.HELP: Reference tools using [Label](tool://tool_id) syntax. Tool IDs are auto-extracted into the scenario's allowed tool list on save.

TOOLS.LABEL: Allowed tools
TOOLS.HELP: Pick which tools this scenario agent can use. Tools referenced in the instruction with [Label](tool://id) syntax are merged in automatically.
TOOLS.EMPTY: No tools available. Open the parent assistant's Custom Tools page to add some.

CUSTOM_TOOLS.EMPTY: No custom tools yet. Add one to let assistants call your APIs.

FORM.HEADER_HINT: Define an HTTP-based tool your assistants can call.

DESCRIPTION.LABEL: Description
DESCRIPTION.PLACEHOLDER: Fetches order details from our backend

ENDPOINT_URL.LABEL: Endpoint URL
ENDPOINT_URL.HELP: Must use HTTPS. Use {{var}} placeholders for parameter substitution.

AUTH_CONFIG.HEADER_NOTE: API key is sent as a request header.

REQUEST_TEMPLATE.LABEL: Request Body Template (Liquid)
REQUEST_TEMPLATE.HELP: Optional. Used for POST requests. Liquid syntax with parameters.

RESPONSE_TEMPLATE.LABEL: Response Template (Liquid)
RESPONSE_TEMPLATE.HELP: Optional. Format the API response before passing to the LLM. Use {{ r }} or {{ response }} to access the parsed response body.

RATE_LIMIT.LABEL: Rate limit (calls per minute)
RATE_LIMIT.HELP: Per-account cap. The agent gets a friendly message when this tool exceeds the limit.

DELETE.TITLE: Delete Custom Tool
DELETE.DESCRIPTION: Delete '{title}'? Scenarios still referencing this tool will fail to validate.

PLAYGROUND.DESCRIPTION: Test conversations with this assistant without affecting any real inbox.
PLAYGROUND.MESSAGE_PLACEHOLDER: Type a message to test the assistant...
PLAYGROUND.CREDIT_NOTE: Playground messages do not count against your live conversation usage.
PLAYGROUND.ERROR: Could not get a response. Please try again.
